application_sentences: It is suitable for all tests starting from an initial gauge length of 10 mm.
The Clip-on extensometer are particularly suitable for determining the module of elasticity, proof stress and ultimate strain.
The operation is quick, straight­forward and easy, and therefore enables efficient tests of a large number of items.

struction Easy changing of extended measuring arm (gauge length) Adjustable clamping force Low activating force Extensometer series MFX The extensometer MFX is suitable for almost all samples from a gauge length (Lo) of 10 mm.

ea possible Available also in high resolution (0,01 μm) version Long stroke Extensometer L700 / L1100 The long stroke extensometer L700 / L1100 is particularly suitable for determining the elongation at break of plastics / elastomers with high elongation.
With its robust construction and precise mechanics, it is suitable for both standard applications and demanding testing conditions.
For tests under thermal influence, the device is also available in a climatic chamber version, suitable for temperatures ranging from +1 °C to +260 °C.

(climatic chamber version) Extensometer MFE – Specialist for High Elongations The MFE extensometer is a long-travel arm strain measurement device, specifically designed for applications involving very high elongations – ideal for testing rubber, elastomers, and plastics.
For testing under thermal conditions, the MFX is also available with climatic chamber measuring arms, rated for use at temperatures of up to 350 °C.
